answers.inspiration:
As cliche as it is, 1000% my mom. She is one independent, strong woman who has always supported me no matter what. She had dreams of her profession when she was a kid (same as me), and through years of hard work and perseverance she achieved those dreams and more! I hope to follow in her footsteps!

*Also, just wanted to note I’m one of Eric Ye’s friends!
